atomic_cutover: api/auth moves to modules/identityaccess/inbound/auth in one PR under the ADR 0020 relocation declaration (policy epoch 19), keeping owner inbound-auth and its roles, so the other 26 keys keep issue #2736 under the new path. Three imports disappear in the same PR. The tenant shell resolves operations.parent_notes_enabled through its own fail-open resolver: same key, same true fallback, same Warn level. The grade_level_max bounds 1..13 are local constants. The *bun.DB handle, which the ignored db argument of tenant.WithTenantTx and WithAdminTx made a mere switch, becomes the consumer-owned UnitOfWork port backed by tenant.WithinCurrentTenant and tenant.WithinAdmin.
